note: Both sets capture the core results — ω_φn = sqrt(K_φ/M_φ), ζ_φ = C_φ/(2√(K_φM_φ)), the negative ∂P/∂θ in Region 3, the derivative/proportional/integral term effects, and the Ref. [10] targets of 0.6 rad/s and ζ_φ = 0.6–0.7 — and both are heavily redundant. A uniquely gets the generator-torque controller's negative damping and the second-order response type right, but omits the K_p gain expression (Eq. 7-14) and the recommendation to neglect the derivative gain, and it adds two trivial claims whose "values" are only misread symbols (ω_φqn, ζ_φs) plus one claim with an edited quote and wrong conditions. B uniquely gets both PI gain expressions and all three Ref. [10] recommendations, but omits the generator-torque negative damping and second-order response, and it twice misbinds the ∂P/∂θ sensitivity (once calling it 'rotor-blade angle' and dropping the pitch-to-feather condition, once making the turbine the entity). With comparable error counts and each missing roughly two important facts, the sets are effectively equivalent in quality.
